newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bridgestone said seeking offers, rubber trade dull.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone said seeking offers, rubber trade dull.

text.p: Bridgestone is said to be asking for offers in the market for SIR20 rubber while the rest of the Singapore rubber market was untraded by midday on Monday in dull conditions, dealers said.
"We heard Bridgestone is asking around for offers for SIR20 rubber, but no deals have been done yet," a dealer for a foreign rubber trading house said.
Traders said Bridgestone will probably be looking for forward supplies of SIR20 rubber and the price will probably range between 50.00 and 51.00 U.S. cents a kg.
The rest of the market remained quiet, dealers said.
"There's just no sustained buying going on, just the occasional spot business," one trader said.
"It's been really flat this morning. We've had no deals so far," another dealer said.
At around 0445 GMT, the May RSS3 contract was indicated at 119.75 U.S. cents a kg from last Thursday's close of 120 cents. The Singapore rubber market was closed on Friday.

May RSS1 was indicated at 172.75 Singapore cents (US$1.20) a kg from last Thursday's 173.50 Singapore cents. May TSR20 was indicated at 160.00 Singapore cents (US$1.11) a kg against 161.75 cents. -- (US$1-S$1.44) Rene Pastor (65-8703305)
